description: Blind per-frame exposure gain estimate: compares this frame's own rail-excluding raw percentile span (per channel) against the anchor frame's span, and rescales the anchor's known-good DirectPF gain by the inverse ratio. See nikonlook_core.py's estimate_gains() docstring for the full derivation. NOT numerically gated against the Gate-7 holdout set -- see manifest.json's quality note.
